data.narrative:
Armadin is a Defense & Security frontier-tech company founded by Kevin Mandia, Travis Lanham, David Slater, and Evan Pena. The company's current valuation and funding history remain undisclosed. The relevant comp universe comprises 10 identifiable peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms—drawn from a broader Defense & Security sector containing 23 companies.

Peer-median valuation proved inapplicable due to insufficient clustering. Despite 23 same-sector peers existing in the dataset, none met the filtering criteria for stage-matching (same-stage or adjacent-stage) or comparable valuation tier. This absence of three or more comparables at Armadin's specific stage and scale precludes meaningful median-based triangulation. The top private peer set identifies Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems as relevant reference points, though stage and valuation comparability remain unclear from available data.

The analysis cannot currently support a quantitative valuation range. Reliable triangulation requires either: (1) disclosure of Armadin's funding stage and valuation tier to enable targeted peer filtering, or (2) expansion of stage/valuation data for the identified peer set. The public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) may offer directional context but require explicit financial multiples and growth metrics to be applied responsibly. Without meeting minimum comparability thresholds, any range estimate would lack analytical grounding.
